Manx: erlhiam dy vel ta mee clashtyn strinnoogh
yamys gow-jee seose as jean doostey maayl as
nee mayd jeh noght s'mie shen cre nee oo hene
neem's fosley yn hooley kiart dy liooar
neemayd geddyn yn londeyryn neesht bee eh dorraghey ayns y tunnel
er lhiam dy ren mee clashtyn peiagh ennagh shooyl mygeayrt er nyn skyn
foddee nagh vel maayl as paayl nyn gadley foast
foddee agh v'eh sheeanal myr doo
er y pheiagh gow-jee seose as jean-jee jeeaghyn
as gowjee kiarail nagh jean peiagh erbee fakin shiu
ta shin nyn jengaghyn ghooinney beemayd cha feagh as lughee as cha tappee as conneeyn
dy beagh shiu nyn jengaghyn woieaghyn cha beagh shiu ayns y voayl custey shoh ayns y chied ynnyd
va shin neuluckee ghooinney ren jamys jarrood yn balley
as ren uss tuittym yn kied-imman ayd ayns y rank
cha nee drogh lurg shen woieaghyn
